name: FCMB
source: NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | CRON 20260929_203951: net finance costs and profit before tax filled from the audited statement, and the income tax row rescaled to the file's unit with unverified stray cells blanked

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.note: FCMB Group consolidated statement of profit or loss, page 50 and directors' report page 28, group column: total tax charge 24,829,463 for FY2025 and 38,557,702 for FY2024 (windfall tax 17,671,442 plus minimum tax 3,289,172 plus taxation charge 17,597,088), in thousands of naira, multiplied by one thousand to the file's absolute scale so the row matches the rest of the statement. The row previously held single figures 8 and 19 in two cells, which are not tax amounts, and carried the FY2024 figure in the FY2023 column, so those cells are left empty rather than carried forward.

rows.label: Net Finance Costs
rows.note: FCMB Group consolidated statement of profit or loss, page 50, group column, line Interest expense note 9 (499 422 106) and (396 503 592) in thousands of naira, multiplied by one thousand because the file stores absolute naira (gross earnings 1,131,774,786 thousand). Net interest income 505,907,000 on the same page equals interest and discount income 1,005,329,106 less 499,422,106.

rows.label: Profit Before Tax
rows.note: FCMB Group consolidated statement of profit or loss, page 50, group column, and the directors' report on page 28, line Profit before minimum tax and income tax 202,100,396 and 111,895,170 in thousands of naira, multiplied by one thousand to the file's absolute scale. It ties: profit before tax 202,100,396 less the three printed tax lines (windfall tax 7,573,475 plus minimum tax 4,886,994 plus taxation charge 12,368,994, total 24,829,463) equals the printed profit for the year 177,270,933. FY2023 to FY2021 are left empty because this report prints only two comparative years.
